text: dsh-perch-notify 是 DSH 会话 webhook 通知插件。它监听全局 session/event 事件，在审批请求或轮次结束时向配置的地址发送提醒。通知可用通用 JSON、ntfy 或 Bark 格式，内容包括事件类型、会话标识和时间；审批还带工具名称与简短原因，轮次结束则带轮次及结束原因。用户可指定要接收的事件，适合希望及时获知待审批操作或会话完成情况的 DSH 使用者。设置 DSH_NOTIFY_URL 启用，并可调整格式与事件类型。

dsh-perch-notify sends DSH session alerts to a configured webhook. It listens for approval requests and completed turns, with JSON, ntfy, or Bark formatting. Messages identify the event and session; approval alerts can include a tool name and reason. Set DSH_NOTIFY_URL to enable delivery.
想在有操作等待审批时收到 webhook 提醒。
DSH 一轮执行结束后，能自动通知我的接收端吗？
Send me a webhook when a DSH approval is waiting.
dsh-perch-notify 的功能「会话事件 webhook 提醒」：监听 DSH 会话事件，在配置的审批请求或轮次结束事件发生时，向指定 URL 发送通知。支持 JSON、ntfy 或 Bark 格式，并可配置转发事件。
dsh-perch-notify 会向 DSH_NOTIFY_URL 配置的接收端 POST 事件类型、会话标识和时间；审批事件还可能包含工具名称与原因，轮次结束事件包含轮次和结束原因。未配置 URL 时不会发送。

Webhook notifications for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) sessions: get a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends. Works with any profile that runs sessions (`web`, `tui`, `acp`, `sdk`, your own).

Use it with [ntfy.sh](https://ntfy.sh), [Bark](https://bark.day.app), a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint that accepts a POST.

dsh-perch-notify README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenweigao/dsh-perch-notify
```

The package is plain JavaScript with no build step, so a git install needs no `prepare` script and no pnpm build allowlist.

dsh-perch-notify README · Configure：Set the destination in the environment before launching dsh:

```sh
export DSH_NOTIFY_URL="https://ntfy.sh/my-topic"     # where notifications go
export DSH_NOTIFY_FORMAT="ntfy"                       # json (default) | ntfy | bark
export DSH_NOTIFY_EVENTS="turn/end,approval/asked"    # optional; this is the default
dsh web

Or pin the same values in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (patch rows replace whole config values, so restate what you keep):

dsh-perch-notify README · Configure：```yaml
- id: perch-notify
  name: dsh-perch-notify
  config:
    url: https://ntfy.sh/my-topic

With no `url` the plugin loads inert and sends nothing.

dsh-perch-notify README · What it sends：The plugin observes the session event log (`session/event`) and forwards **lifecycle facts only** — never prompts, replies, tool arguments, or file contents.

`json` format (default) posts:

```json
{
  "event": "turn/end",
  "sessionId": "3d60430f-…",
  "time": "2026-09-21T13:29:56.155Z",

An approval request arrives as `{"event": "approval/asked", …, "detail": {"toolName": "bash", "reason": "…"}}`.

dsh-perch-notify README · What it sends：`ntfy` format posts the text with `Title`/`Tags` headers so phones ring; `bark` format posts Bark's `{title, body}` shape.

Delivery failures are logged to the dsh console and never block or retry the agent.

dsh-perch-notify README · Privacy：One outbound POST per matching event to your own endpoint, off by default without a URL. No other network calls, no telemetry, no storage outside dsh's own session log.

dsh-perch-notify README · Origin：Built by the author of [Perch](https://github.com/chenweigao/perch), a native macOS workspace for remote agents (including dsh over ACP). If you want approvals and turn completion on your Mac desktop instead of a webhook, that is what Perch does.

dsh-perch-notify README · 中文：dsh 会话的 webhook 通知插件：审批等待、轮次结束时向你自己的地址发 POST。支持 ntfy / Bark / 任意 JSON 接收端，任何跑会话的 profile（web、tui、acp、sdk）都能用。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenweigao/dsh-perch-notify
export DSH_NOTIFY_URL="https://ntfy.sh/my-topic"
export DSH_NOTIFY_FORMAT="ntfy"
dsh web

纯 JavaScript、无构建步骤，git 安装不需要 pnpm allowlist。插件只转发生命周期事实（哪类事件、哪个会话、哪个工具要审批），不发送提示词、回复、工具参数或文件内容；未配置 URL 时完全不动作。

由 [Perch](https://github.com/chenweigao/perch) 的作者构建——如果你想在 Mac 原生界面里直接处理审批和完成通知，而不是走 webhook，那是 Perch 干的事。
